title: From Consumer Insight to Growth: The Future of Retail Media
summary: P&G's Jacques Hagopian on retail media's future: consumer insights drive profitable growth.
body_markdown:
## Innovation Happens Through Partnership


One of my favorite examples began during a simple dinner conversation. In chatting with a retail partner at Albertsons, the discussion sparked a thought about doing something different, leveraging data and insights Albertsons had with the unique storytelling history P&G could bring.


That conversation ultimately led to the creation of[Rico's Tacos](https://us.pg.com/blogs/hispanic-heritage-month/) , a short-form, comedy-drama series developed with supermarket-level ad sales. The series is about a taco vendor and his teenage daughter navigating authenticity, ambition and the future of their family business. With participating brands like Head & Shoulders, Vicks and Bounty, each episode introduces unexpected customers who help turn the humble taco cart into a neighborhood obsession.


This initiative combined shopper insights, engaging content and commerce experiences in ways that went well beyond traditional banner ads or sponsored search. Albertsons had a rich data set of different types of shopper trips and the different “missions” shoppers had. We brought our storytelling expertise to help create “snackable” stories that consumers wanted to engage with. This content was not only entertaining, but deeply relevant, driving traffic and commerce within the Albertsons’ ecosystem.


What made it successful wasn't the technology. It was the willingness to rethink the model. The result was a more engaging consumer experience and a stronger business outcome.
